claim_summary: Autoregressive LLMs project system prompts, tool schemas, RAG chunks, and tool outputs into a single flat sequence of token embeddings without hardware privilege rings (Ring 0/Ring 3) or SQL parse-tree separation
notes: Uses complementary CPU Ring 0/Ring 3 and parameterized SQL analogies validated at GATE-02.

claim_summary: At step 1 with a 600-token system prompt and 1,800 tokens per step, system instructions represent 25.00% of the context window (2,400 total tokens)
At step 10 (18,600 tokens) and step 25 (45,600 tokens), system prompt share drops to 3.23% and 1.32% respectively
At step 40 with 1,800 tokens added per step, total uncompacted context is 72,600 tokens (crossing a 50k compaction threshold) and system prompt share drops to 0.83%
Even when the system prompt is pinned at index 0, transformer attention over long contexts is non-uniform and negative constraints compete with recent concrete action patterns
notes: Qualifies the token-share table so it does not equate raw token percentage with uniform attention degradation.

claim_summary: Under independent steps with p=0.95 and N=10, single-trajectory reliability P_traj is 0.95^10 = 59.87% (59.9%)
Trajectory table across p in {0.95, 0.90, 0.85} and N in {1, 5, 10, 15}: e.g., at p=0.90, N=10 gives 34.9% and N=15 gives 20.6%; at p=0.85, N=15 gives 8.7%
With P_traj = 59.87% and k=5 runs, pass@5 (at least one success in 5 runs) is 1 - (1 - 0.5987)^5 = 98.96%
With P_traj = 59.87% and k=5 runs, pass^5 (5 consecutive successes) is (0.5987)^5 = 7.69%
Step independence fails in two opposing ways in practice: negative correlation (error cascades over corrupted state) and positive recovery (closed-loop validation errors on read-only calls)
notes: Crucial qualification avoiding naive presentation of p^N.

notes: Demonstrates Correction #4: calibrated conclusion separating hard guarantees from open probabilistic trade-offs.

notes: Synthesizes control-flow ownership definitions across corpus.

claim_summary: run_bounded_refund_workflow executes refund triage in a deterministic state machine using exactly 1 LLM call (CLASSIFY_INTENT) while handling eligibility and execution in Python

notes: All 5 states defined with explicit retryable flags.

claim_summary: Unredirected print() calls to stdout inside a STDIO MCP/JSON-RPC tool server corrupt the JSON-RPC wire frame; redirect_stdout captures stray driver output into diagnostic_stderr
notes: Addresses real bug identified in competing textbook MCP code (SRC-001 Section 4).

notes: Used to calibrate when to choose MCP vs direct in-process Python contracts.

claim_summary: Rule of Two (Lethal Trifecta prevention): a single autonomous session may combine at most two of {READ_PRIVATE_DATA, READ_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT, SEND_EXTERNAL_COMMUNICATION / MUTATE_INTERNAL_STATE}
notes: Enforced at runtime by CapabilityTaintGateway.

claim_summary: Pre-prompt ACL filtering (retrieve_with_pre_prompt_acl) enforces document permissions before vector similarity ranking and prompt construction
notes: Prevents post-retrieval leakage of unauthorized high-relevance chunks.

claim_summary: Deterministic SHA-256 idempotency key derived from (workflow_run_id, logical_step_id, tool_name, canonical_args) prevents both network-timeout duplicates and LLM cognitive re-execution

claim_summary: AuthoritativeStateDiff computes a SHA-256 hash over before/after state and taint status to prevent TOCTOU drift while a request sits in the human review queue
notes: Requires active resource_id confirmation challenge.

notes: Exact match with verify_ch06_7_8_9_10_calcs.py.

claim_summary: Wilson 95% confidence interval around a 90% observed pass rate spans [74.4%, 96.5%] at n=30 vs [85.1%, 93.4%] at n=200
notes: Demonstrates why +/-3% prompt tweaks on n=30 are statistical noise.

claim_summary: Observing 0 failures in n=10 red-team trials leaves an exact 95% upper-bound failure risk of 25.89% (1 - 0.05^(1/10)); n=30 leaves 9.50%; n=100 leaves 2.95%
notes: Exact binomial bound alongside 3/n Rule of Three.

claim_summary: DeterministicFaultInjector injects seeded HTTP 503, schema drift, and hook exceptions; critical tool failures halt fail-safe while optional reads degrade with explicit FieldEpistemicStatus tags

claim_summary: TamperEvidentAuditLog scrubs email PII and bearer/API secrets in memory before serialization and chains events with SHA-256 digests

claim_summary: evaluate_release_gate enforces 4 hard non-deployment triggers (missing owner/kill-switch, missing taint/out-of-band checks, fail-open chaos violations, ECST > manual cost) and gates Tier 1/2/3 progression
notes: Synthesizes all four rings into an objective go/no-go audit.

verify_pinned_tool_schema computes a canonical SHA-256 digest over MCP tool name, description, and input_schema to block runtime tool poisoning and silent description rug pulls

claim_summary: ProvenanceGatedMemoryVault blocks persistent memory writes from tainted sessions or unverified trajectories and sanitizes imperative override patterns on retrieval
notes: Defends against cross-session delayed memory poisoning (ASI06).

claim_summary: DeterministicSagaCoordinator executes LIFO reverse-order compensating actions when a multi-tool workflow fails at step k, recording SAGA_ABORTED_AND_COMPENSATED or SAGA_QUARANTINED_MANUAL_RECONCILIation
notes: Solves cross-service rollback for non-transactional external APIs.

claim_summary: Pollaczek-Khinchine M/G/1 formula shows that at rho=0.75 and mu=20/hr, increasing service-time variance from C_s^2=0.0 (deterministic) to C_s^2=4.0 (bursty forensic escalations) increases wait time W_q from 4.50 min to 22.50 min (5x)

claim_summary: Pooling two dedicated M/M/1 reviewer queues (lambda=18/hr, mu=20/hr, rho=0.90) into a single M/M/2 queue (lambda_total=36/hr, c=2, rho=0.90) cuts mean wait time W_q from 27.00 min to 12.79 min (52.6% reduction)

claim_summary: McNemar's exact paired test on N=100 tasks: a +5% accuracy gain with discordant pairs (b=7 regressions, c=12 improvements) yields p=0.3593 (noise), whereas (b=1, c=11, +10% gain) yields p=0.0063 (statistically significant)
notes: Prevents deploying prompt changes based on uncorrelated sampling noise.

claim_summary: verify_safe_command_invocation parses commands via shlex.split, rejects shell metacharacters, enforces an explicit binary allowlist, and requires subprocess.run(..., shell=False) to defeat 'rm -rf' flag-reordering bypasses
notes: Fixes the broken substring blacklist hook anti-pattern from competing literature.

claim_summary: replay_incident_trace_against_patched_gateway replays recorded ToolProposal traces deterministically against upgraded gateway policies in CI/CD without re-sampling the LLM
notes: Turns every production incident into a deterministic <50ms CI regression test.

claim_summary: Population Stability Index (PSI) across 5 behavioral buckets scores 0.0030 under normal weekly variance (<0.10 threshold) and jumps to 0.4943 under silent upstream model drift (>=0.25 auto-demotion trigger)
notes: Quantifies post-deployment drift across the 8 drift axes.
